title: Notable dates move to the page footer on desktop

history.detail:
PASS: PASS, gate 1, audit of f8787ca.

Sprint file: read fresh. Unchanged since start (791c297 is the only commit touching it).

Handoff: read at the audited commit. It has a Round 1 section quoting VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0, with 600 tests.

Diff: f8787ca's parent is 6960485, after the sprint 51 merge (b389c5c), so the diff is sprint 50 alone.

My own check: npm run verify at f8787ca, on a clean tree. Result: verify=0, VERIFY PASS exit=0, 53 test files and 600 tests passed.

- R1 Met. DateNavigation no longer renders the list or takes isoDate. page.tsx's belowDateBand holds only DatePicker and DateNavigation. afterBody now ends with NotableDatesPanel (desktopOnly), so on desktop it comes after the body and is the card's last shown section.
- R2 Met as far as a static audit can tell. The heading, list, item, link, current-date and tooltip rules are untouched. The only new declarations are on .notablePanel: padding 12px 40px 14px and border-top 1px var(--om-rule). Each is sourced in the handoff and in a CSS comment (flowSlot's gutter and bottom padding, the removed adjacent-plus-strip 12px, and dateNav's rule). The rename from Strip to Panel touches class and id names only; the JSX inside is unchanged.
  Dev Team's computed-style fingerprints before and after are identical. The pixel difference is explained as sub-pixel text positioning, by an inference Dev Team states plainly. LiveQA's step 1 visual comparison settles it.
- R3 Met. NotableDatesSection is unchanged. The phone probe matches sprint 48's round 2 report.
- R4 Met. In the anchor path, position-try-fallbacks adds flip-block and flip-block flip-inline. Closed tooltips are still display none. The containing block follows the rename (main:has(.notablePanel)).
  The measurement table shows closed and max-open scrollWidth equal to the viewport at all seven widths, scrollHeight unchanged while open, and all 20 tooltips inside the card and the viewport.
  I opened after-1280-bottom-last-row-tooltip.png: 11 March 2020's tooltip opens upward, inside the card. While open, it covers part of the row above, which is expected for an open tooltip.
  The fallback path is unchanged: sprint 45's accepted limitation, which R4 allows.
- R5 Met. A grep for notableStrip, NotableDatesStrip and notable-dates-strip across app and lib finds only the explanatory comment at date.module.css:190. No selector targets the old strip position. The adjacent-plus-strip rule is removed.
- R6 Met. The panel is last in the DOM, so it is last in Tab order. This is confirmed in the handoff's browser check.
- R7 Met. NotableDates.test.tsx and notable-dates-page.test.ts are updated and listed in the handoff. The page test asserts the strip holds the picker and day links with no notable dates, the desktop panel is the card's last child after the phone copy, and aria-describedby links each date to its tooltip.
- R8 Met. I opened both required screenshots. after-1280-top-strip.png shows the strip with the picker, Go, the random link and the day links, and no notable dates.

No issues found. Still UNOWNED, with Master Controller: the 3 lint warnings in the sprint 45 and 46 probe scripts.

For LiveQA: step 1's before/after visual comparison is the real R2 check, since the pixel diff is explained only by inference. Step 4 (Firefox) has not been run by anyone.
commit=f8787ca | ci=green: 1 CI run(s) for f8787ca261482362387206801f95989b47bad0d5 all completed successfully with real steps executed.

PASS: PASS (round 1). LiveQA steps 1, 2, 3 and 5 pass on production, and the R2 before/after comparison was done on local builds of the commits either side of the move. Step 4 (Firefox) not run: only Chromium is installed here. No defects.

Tested 2026-11-25, about 19:40 to 19:55 UTC, against https://my-little-racoon.vercel.app.
Shipped commit f8787ca. Production serves the pushed tip 3cf15e4: /api/health/db reports status ok, connected true, commit 3cf15e4, with migrationVersion unchanged at 20261122152710_navigation_exact_date_readings. f8787ca is an ancestor of origin/main, and git diff f8787ca origin/main changes nothing under app/, lib/ or public/.
Tools: headless Chromium (Playwright 1.57); curl; fresh git clones in a scratch directory.

BEFORE/AFTER REFERENCE (step 1's comparison, R2): I hadn't captured production before the release. Instead I built both sides locally, from fresh clones:
- b389c5c, the app code production served just before this ship;
- f8787ca, the shipped commit.
Each had npm ci exit=0 and npm run build exit=0, and ran with next start and the same dummy env, ports 3950 and 3951. I compared the desktop panel on /date/1969-07-20 at 1280 with computed styles, 28 properties per element:
- Identical before and after: the heading (H2 "Other notable dates"), the list, the list items, the links, the current-date marker (SPAN "20 July 1969"), and the closed tooltip.
- The open tooltip on 6 June 1944 is identical: text, size, background, border, font, colour, padding, shadow and radius.
- Row pitch is identical (19px); the list wraps to the same 3 rows. Content width is the same: before, nav 1054px wide at x 41 inside the card's date strip; after, nav 1134px with 40px side padding, so 1054px of content.
- The only differences are the panel box's own spacing: margin-top 12px became padding-top 12px; padding-bottom 14px was added; and a 1px solid top rule was added, which R2 allows where the card's section rules put one. Class notableStrip became notablePanel.
- Screenshots: s50-tip-3950.png (before) and s50-tip-3951.png (after) look the same, apart from position.
Servers stopped, clones deleted.

STEP 1, production 1280 on /date/1969-07-20: PASS.
- The strip under the date band: the picker row (date, GO, OR, DISCOVER RANDOM READING at y 364), then the day nav "← PREVIOUS DAY 19 July 1969 NEXT DAY → 21 July 1969" (y 426). No notable dates. The chart tabs follow at 475. Screenshot: s50-prod-top-1280.png.
- "Other notable dates": the nav, labelled by notable-dates-panel-heading, is main's last child, at y 1245-1344, directly after the reading (which ends at 1245). The card ends at 1345.
- 20 entries, with 20 July 1969 marked aria-current. Screenshot: s50-prod-bottom-1280.png.

STEP 2, tooltips with the page scrolled to the bottom, at 1280x900: PASS, on hover and on keyboard focus alike.
- First row: 15 April 1912 and 24 October 1945 open below, inside the card and the viewport.
- Middle row: 28 August 1963 opens ABOVE.
- Last row: 11 September 2001 and 11 March 2020 open ABOVE. 11 March 2020: "The WHO declares COVID-19 a pandemic" at x 391-669, y 716-772, with the card's bottom at 802 and the viewport at 900.
- Exactly 1 tooltip shown each time. scrollWidth stayed 1280 and scrollHeight 1443 while open.
- Screenshot: s50-prod-hover-2020-03-11.png. The tooltip covers part of the row above while open, as QA1 noted.

STEP 3, scrollWidth at every width: PASS. On /date/1969-07-20, page scrolled to the bottom, I hovered every one of the 20 dates (so every row's last date) at each width. Closed scrollWidth, then max while open:
- 901: 901, 901
- 1000: 1000, 1000
- 1100: 1100, 1100
- 1200: 1200, 1200
- 1279: 1279, 1279
- 1280: 1280, 1280
- 1440: 1440, 1440
scrollHeight never grew while a tooltip was open (for example 1580 at 901, 1443 at 1280). At every width, every open tooltip was inside the card and the viewport (0 failures).
Rows' last dates: at 901 and 1000, 1944-06-06, 1961-04-12, 1990-02-11 and 2020-03-11; at 1280, 1945-10-24, 1989-11-09 and 2020-03-11.

STEP 4, Firefox: NOT RUN. Playwright has only Chromium installed here, and I did not install Firefox. Chromium supports anchor positioning, so the anchor path is what ran above. The fallback path is untested live; Sprint 45's accepted limitation applies there.

STEP 5, phone 390 on /date/1969-07-20: PASS, unchanged.
- The desktop panel is not visible.
- Order: picker 211, day nav 275, chart tabs 320, reading ending 1101, Discover random reading 1120, "Other notable dates" heading 1191. It has 20 rows, the first "15 April 1912 / The Titanic sinks in the North Atlantic". scrollWidth 390, with JS on and off.
- Random link to heading is 71px, the same as Sprint 48's run (1168 to 1239). Everything is 48px higher than then because Sprint 51 shortened the matched events section.

0 console or page errors.
